+
+    # Check shape consistency

action.old_text: raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
action.new_text:
# Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError('tau_filter must not be a boolean')
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError('tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative')

    # Validate input matrices
    for name, mat in [('logp_with_result', logp_with_result),
                      ('logp_call_only', logp_call_only),
                      ('logp_no_call', logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(mat, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a numpy ndarray')
        if mat.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a 2D matrix')
        if mat.shape[0] == 0 or mat.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be non-empty')
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(mat)):
            raise ValueError(f'{name} contains non-finite values')
        if np.any(mat > 0):
            raise ValueError(f'{name} contains positive values')

    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError('All input matrices must have the same shape')

    # Compute totals
    total_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    total_call = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    total_no = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Compute improvements
    improve_no = total_no - total_with
    improve_call = total_call - total_with

    # Margin is the minimum improvement
    margins = np.minimum(improve_no, improve_call)

    # Keep if margin >= tau_filter
    keep = margins >= tau_filter

    return keep, margins
